Maya (partnerships): Quick sync request — Datadog + OTLP demo for our "copilot" sample app. want a tiny playbook for partners to onboard observability for GPU inference (traces + metrics + a starter dashboard). can Datadog & eng align on what we ship as an example?
Alex (eng-ml): +1. target: show prefix/KV cache hits, batch size distribution, per-token latency traces, and model-variant fallback events. short demo that partners can run locally or in a marketplace image.
Jordan (obs-io): I can sketch the OTLP collector config. need to ensure we export span attributes for: model.name, model.revision, seq_len, batch_size, kv_cache_hit (bool), routed_tier. keep PII out.
Sara (Datadog): Sounds good — Datadog side: we can provide a dashboard template + APM service map. want the demo to include a flamegraph of decode latency and a trace tag "inference_shard" for sharded runs. we also prefer resource metrics (gpu_util, mem_used_mb) as timeseries.
Oscar (solutions): For partner onboarding, include a one-click runbook: docker-compose with runtime + otel-collector + dd-agent env vars. short README that shows how to run a 1-min load test that produces traces.
Lee (eng-platform): FYI — Dedicated runtime emits token-level events at debug; we'll add config to sample 1% of token spans to keep volume sane for hosted partners. also adding a header X-Redwood-Routing to traces.
Maya (partnerships): perfect. can we agree on a minimal OTLP config snippet? Jordan, Sara — can you both review this and say if it covers Datadog ingestion?
Jordan (obs-io): here's a minimal collector config we propose (shortened):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: kv_cache_hit
        action: insert
        value: "false"
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
    traces:
      service: redwood-inference
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes, batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Sara (Datadog): That looks fine. two asks: 1) include a resource attribute service.instance.id so we can map GPU nodes. 2) add span attribute sample_rate when we perform token sampling. with those we can wire APM + infra.
Alex (eng-ml): will add service.instance.id = pod_name and sample_rate. also will tag traces with model.revision and route.tier.
Maya (partnerships): Nice. next: dashboard tiles. Sara, can you outline the minimal set we should bundle?
Sara (Datadog): Minimal dashboard: 1) Per-token latency (p50/p95) by model.revision; 2) Batch size histogram; 3) KV cache hit rate; 4) GPU util + memory; 5) Trace waterfall for a single request (sampled). We'll export as a JSON template.
Oscar (solutions): We'll also include a short notebook that queries Datadog for trace error rates and correlates with prompt sets. good for partners to see quality regressions.
Lee (eng-platform): Ops note: recommend enabling OTLP over gRPC on port 4317 in marketplace images, and set resource_limits for collector. also include a SERVICE_TOKEN example for private deployments.
Maya (partnerships): timeline? i'd like a partner-ready artifact (collector config + dashboard + README + 1-click compose) by next Tue. can everyone confirm feasibility?
Alex (eng-ml): feasible, i'll prepare the sample app changes and small load script by Mon.
Jordan (obs-io): I'll draft the collector and a short verification script (curl span) by EOD today.
Sara (Datadog): I'll have the dashboard JSON and a short ingest checklist by Mon morning.
Oscar (solutions): I'll draft the onboarding README + compose, and the notebook by Tue.
Lee (eng-platform): I'll add the collector port + sampling config to the marketplace image this week.
Deploy Bot: deployment scheduled: staging/otlp-demo -> 2054321150 by Maya (partnerships). :rocket:
Maya (partnerships): thanks all. follow-ups: @Sara please include small screenshots for the dashboard template so PMs can preview. @Alex remind me if we need any model artifact changes for the sample.
Sara (Datadog): will add screenshots.
Alex (eng-ml): will check model bundle size and remove debug token events by default.
Maya (partnerships): one more thing — legal requested a short blurb about telemetry: "what we collect" + retention guidance for partners. can Solutions + Datadog draft a line?
Oscar (solutions): draft: "We collect non-PII operational telemetry (metrics, traces) to help monitor inference performance. Partners control ingestion destinations and retention via Datadog settings or self-hosted collectors."
Sara (Datadog): fine from our side. can legal review later.
Maya (partnerships): perfect. closing — i'll open a GH repo and add everyone to the PR. ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
